digest.component_or_area: bridge fsck audit and store integrity
propositions: Phantom SYNC-dependent fsck checks (orphaned, duplicates, stale) short-circuit and return empty results; these cells must be removed from structured output and human report.
Unknown event types must be detected via two-stage git-based scan of refs/heads/tickets without requiring a checkout, with both JSON spacing variants detected and nested/comment matches excluded.

Store integrity audit must verify forward/reverse binding consistency offline: confirmed forward entries require non-empty Jira keys with matching reverse entries, and reverse entries must point to confirmed forward entries with matching keys.

Git operational failures (missing executable, missing ref, malformed grep output, exit >=2, candidate-read failure) must raise RebarError with returncode=2 and exit CLI with status 2, while unknown_event_types remain non-gating informational.

Structured fsck output must transition from (orphaned, duplicates, stale) to (unknown_event_types, binding_drift, store_integrity) across CLI, library, MCP schema, generated reference, and all in-repo consumers.
SYNC-related code (_STALE_THRESHOLD_NS, _NS_THRESHOLD, _to_ns, --now-ts) and fixtures must be removed; reconciler liveness detection continues through refs/reconciler/last-pass witness.
